co_north_table_mountain_golden_cliffs.name: North Table Mountain/Golden Cliffs
co_north_table_mountain_golden_cliffs.note: HELD by reviewer: window mapped from season words, no source naming months for both ends. South/west-facing basalt called comfortable winter/cold-weather climbing (MP, Visit Golden); guidebook says cooler months best, summer too hot/greasy; no explicit months, mapped fall-winter-early spring.

ny_the_trapps.name: The Trapps
ny_the_trapps.note: HELD by reviewer: window mapped from season words, no source naming months for both ends. Gunks: Sep-Oct prime, spring also popular (wetter, buggy), Jul-Aug hot and humid; SummitPost ranks spring and fall together; seasons mapped to Mar-May, Sep-Nov.

ut_american_fork_canyon.name: American Fork Canyon
ut_american_fork_canyon.note: HELD by reviewer: window mapped from season words, no source naming months for both ends. Outbound: season spring through fall, winter possible but freezing; second source spring/summer workable with shade, fall singled out; mapped Mar-Nov.

co_castlewood_canyon_sp.name: Castlewood Canyon SP
co_castlewood_canyon_sp.note: Only 'spring to fall' from a weak travel site plus raptor closures Mar-Jul on some walls; no two agreeing month sources.

tx_north_mountain.name: North Mountain
tx_north_mountain.note: Hueco Tanks prime bouldering mid-Nov to mid-Mar (one says to mid-Apr); summer highs over 100F; shared window Nov-Mar.

ky_muir_valley.name: Muir Valley
ky_muir_valley.note: Reviewer: set to the Red River Gorge system window confirmed high in research-01a (Northern Gorge/MFRP/PMRP). Red River Gorge guides name spring and fall best (fall prime, Sep-Oct to just after Thanksgiving; spring Apr-Jun), summer hot and humid; not Muir-specific but sources speak for the whole Gorge.

co_rifle_mountain_park.name: Rifle Mountain Park
co_rifle_mountain_park.note: Sources give April-November and mid-April to late October; spring and fall ideal, summer mornings/evenings; shared window Apr-Oct; winter is ice.

ut_rock_canyon.name: Rock Canyon
ut_rock_canyon.note: Several Provo guides name April, May, September, October as best; winter possible on sunny walls.

ut_saint_george.name: Saint George
ut_saint_george.note: HELD by reviewer: window mapped from season words, no source naming months for both ends. Guides say fall through spring is the climbing season (spring Mar-May arguably best); summer hot; mapped Sep-May.

co_south_fork_of_st_vrain_canyon.name: South Fork of St. Vrain Canyon
co_south_fork_of_st_vrain_canyon.note: MP says best in summer and fall but climbable year-round; only one source names a best window, the other lists all months.

co_lumpy_ridge.name: Lumpy Ridge
co_lumpy_ridge.note: Rock climbing April to October (NatGeo), spring-summer-fall (Outdoor Project); south-facing so hot in midsummer, good sunny winter days; raptor closures Feb 15/Mar 1-Jul 31 on many formations.

az_1_lower_highway.name: Lower Highway
az_1_lower_highway.note: Mt Lemmon forum: Oct-May is the climbing season, Jun-Aug very hot, monsoon Jul-Aug; SummitPost spring and fall; low-elevation crag so warmest; some Catalina closures Jan-Jul for falcons.
